# Accessibility Review

Use `accessibility-audit`.

Review semantic structure, labels, keyboard-only operation, visible focus, dialog focus, contrast, status announcements, zoom/reflow, touch target comfort, captions, timeline alternatives and reduced motion. Run automated scans where available, then manually verify critical workflows. Do not claim WCAG conformance from an automated scan alone. Report findings with severity, reproduction, evidence and remediation. No code changes unless requested as a new approved slice.
